title: Italy gives national strategic interest designation to Sardinia data centre with hybrid energy storage hub
summary: Italy has designated Energy Vault's AI data centre in Sardinia as a project of national strategic interest, highlighting its commitment to renewable energy and innovation.
body_markdown:
# Italy gives national strategic interest designation to Sardinia data centre with hybrid energy storage hub


Energy Vault | 7 September 2026


The Italian government has declared an AI data centre in development by Energy Vault, featuring renewable energy and hybrid energy storage technologies, to be of strategic national interest.
